utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Please call the case, Mr. Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. This is case number IT-05-88-A, the Prosecutor versus Vujadin Popovic et al. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Appearances for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. SCHNEIDER
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Todd Schneider on behalf of the Office of the Prosecution, along with Francois Boudreault and Janet Stewart.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. For the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. For Vujadin Popovic, Zoran Zivanovic as counsel. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. John Ostojic on behalf of Ljubisa Beara.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning. Jelena Nikolic for Mr. Drago Nikolic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And ...

utterances.speaker: MS. FAUVEAU
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Natacha Fauveau Ivanovic for General Miletic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. JOSSE
utterances.text: Your Honour, David Josse, along with my lead counsel Dragan Krgovic, for the absent Milan Gvero.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Now Mr. Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: MR. DAVIS
utterances.text: [Via teleconference] Good morning, Your Honour. It's Simon Davis for Vinko Pandurevic. Good morning, everyone. Good morning, Mr. Pandurevic. I'm sorry that I'm not with you today and for any inconvenience and/or disappointment this may have caused due to court commitments in the UK. I am grateful to the Court for arranging the telephone link facility so that I may participate in the hearing.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Well, thank you very much. Inconvenience, certainly yes. I'm not sure about the disappointment. But we're very glad to -- that you are there, and I just wanted to ensure that Mr. Pandurevic -- Mr. Pandurevic, you have consented to this procedure? THE APPELLANT PANDUREVIC: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour. Yes. I have. I understand fully.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes. That was a question, not a statement. Let me begin by giving a brief summary of the pending motions before the Chamber. First, with respect to the briefing process, the B/C/S translation of the trial judgement in this case was filed on the 3rd of January, 2012. On the same day, the Appeals Chamber issued an order, setting a time-limit to file any amended grounds of appeal. The order sets the date by which any amendments are to be filed as 3rd of May, 2012. Secondly, with respect to pending motions there are the following. Two motions filed under Rule 115 on behalf of Mr. Popovic. These are the third and fourth motions under Rule 115 filed confidentially by counsel for Mr. Popovic on 15th of August and 19 September, 2011, respectively. All responses and replies to these motions were filed and these motions remain under consideration by the Appeals Chamber. A motion was filed confidentially by the Prosecution on the 18th of November, 2011, seeking -- yes?

utterances.speaker: MR. SCHNEIDER
utterances.text: I apologise, Your Honour. Perhaps we could move into private session to discuss that and other pending confidential motions.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes, let's move into a private session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're back in open session, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: A motion was filed by the accused in the Radovan Karadzic proceedings on the 8th of December, 2011, for access to confidential material in the appellant proceedings of the Popovic case. The Prosecution filed its reply on 12th December 2011, and the Chamber is to give a decision shortly. May I now ask the appellants whether they wish to raise any concerns regarding their health or the conditions of their detention. Mr. Popovic. THE APPELLANT POPOVIC: [Interpretation] Thank you for your concern. I have no problems to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: I'm glad to hear that. Thanks. Mr. Beara. THE APPELLANT BEARA: [Interpretation] Nothing to raise. Everything is in good order.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thanks. Mr. Nikolic. THE APPELLANT NIKOLIC: [Interpretation] Mr. President, I'm in good health. I have no objections or remarks to make with regard to the conditions in detention. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Miletic. THE APPELLANT MILETIC: [Interpretation] Mr. President, I have -- I'm experiencing no problems. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. Pandurevic. THE APPELLANT PANDUREVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, the conditions in detention are good and my health is in good state. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: May I ask whether any of the counsel would have anything to say?

utterances.speaker: MR. SCHNEIDER
utterances.text: No, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Doesn't appear so. It only remains for me to express my gratitude to the Registry for very quickly arranging the telephone connection with London, and we are very grateful to you, Mr. Simon Davis.

utterances.speaker: MR. DAVIS
utterances.text: [Via teleconference] Thank you, Your Honour. And thank you for allowing me to participate in this way.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Not at all.

utterances.speaker: MR. DAVIS
utterances.text: [Via teleconference] Good morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: There being no other matters, the hearing is adjourned.
